description: This file defines a PHP class 'Language' within the 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Event' namespace. The class extends a controller and manages event-driven actions related to language data, such as dumping language variables before a controller loads, backing up language data before specific events, and restoring language data after events. The file is part of the administrative backend of OpenCart, specifically handling language-related events.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class for handling language event-related operations such as dumping language variables into templates, backing up language data before controller actions, and restoring language data after events.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to dump all language variables into the template, ensuring each variable is set in the args array for rendering.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Event handler that runs before a controller loads, backing up current language data into a JSON-encoded string stored in the language system.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Event handler that runs after a controller action, restoring language variables from the backup stored prior to the controller load.
